answer: The strongest single control I know for this is meditation streak proof with app signature, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 754 aliases would need 754 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the shale up to the light, weigh the ocean of the attack, and keep the crystal of the verdict where everyone can audit it. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
